summary: Comprehensive frontend-only testing of Duarte's Limpezas single-page marketing site. All 14 requested feature areas pass: loader dismisses, hero renders headline, navbar with 6 nav links and CTA (correct wa.me href), Hero orcamento & whatsapp buttons with correct hrefs, exactly 8 service cards with service-specific WhatsApp messages, 10 differentials, 5 how-it-works steps, service-area section, 5 gallery items with working lightbox (open/close via button and ESC), 3 testimonials, 6 FAQ triggers with accordion behavior (first open by default), CTA final with wa.me + tel:+5544997069677, footer with phone/email/social hrefs, floating WhatsApp always visible, back-to-top appears after 500px scroll and returns to top. Mobile viewport 390x844 has no horizontal overflow, hamburger toggle opens all 6 mobile nav links. No console errors observed. All data-testids resolved correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: FAQ trigger buttons do not expose aria-expanded attribute (accessibility improvement, not blocking).
Minor: Lightbox prev/next arrow buttons lack data-testid (functional but not covered by explicit test hooks); ESC and close button work correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is a static frontend-only React app. WhatsApp phoneRaw=5544997069677 in /app/frontend/src/data/site.js. All CTAs use waLink() helper which produces https://wa.me/5544997069677?text=... Verified: navbar-cta, hero-orcamento-btn, hero-whatsapp-btn, service-cta-0..7 (each contains the specific service title in text param, e.g. service-cta-0 contains 'Limpeza de Caixa d'Agua'), cta-final-whatsapp, cta-final-call (tel:+5544997069677), footer-phone/email/instagram/facebook/whatsapp, floating-whatsapp. Gallery lightbox opens/closes via close button and ESC; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keys wired. FAQ first item open by default via useState(0). Mobile menu opens with all 6 mobile-nav-* links. No console errors. Hero background video may log ERR_ABORTED (harmless per spec).
